content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CSIR NIO Principal Project Associate Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 04-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CSIR NIO to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by CSIR National Institute of Oceanography (CSIR NIO) for filling up temporary research positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by CSIR NIO?
faq.answer: CSIR NIO has advertised for the post of Principal Project Associate under advertisement number GAP003897/3320-26.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Principal Project Associate position in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for Principal Project Associate?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MSc in Marine Biology / Marine Sciences / Oceanography / Biotechnology / Microbiology or equivalent with a minimum of 6 years of post-MSc research experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary for the Principal Project Associate post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Principal Project Associate post will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 49,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to apply for CSIR NIO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications for the CSIR NIO Principal Project Associate recruitment is 04-10-2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: Applications for the Principal Project Associate posts must be submitted exclusively through online mode by visiting the official website.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for applying to these temporary research positions.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I apply online for CSIR NIO Principal Project Associate?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online directly through the official application portal link provided on the CSIR NIO website.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed and downloaded directly from the Important Links section of this article or the CSIR NIO website.
